Note the asymmetry, which is a property of the tool and not of this document: the cwd path serves the READ-ONLY verb only. From that same cwd, against this same absolute path, `ddocs set` refuses with E433 'address resolves outside the repository' and `ddocs build` refuses with E429 'document is outside the repository root'. Cross-repo validation is supported; cross-repo writes are not, so this document has no generated sibling markdown and the amendment recorded here was authored directly.
